name: dev-dashboard
description: Dashboard local para gerenciamento de projetos de desenvolvimento

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@dev-dashboard/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@dev-dashboard/core && npm run build --workspace=@dev-dashboard/project-discovery && npm run build --workspace=@dev-dashboard/process-manager
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@dev-dashboard/api && npm run build --workspace=@dev-dashboard/web
